components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid blue action (print / save PDF, new document).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">พิมพ์ / บันทึก PDF</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', 'Noto Sans Thai', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.08s; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3d5af1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #3d5af1; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -8px rgba(61,90,241,0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2f4ad8; }

components.name: Soft Button
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-soft">เอกสารทั้งหมด</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-soft { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid #d6dce7; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #18213a; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s, transform 0.08s; } .ds-btn-soft:hover { border-color: #3d5af1; color: #2b44c9; } .ds-btn-soft:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-soft:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3d5af1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Grey-filled field that turns white with a blue halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 360px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #4a5470; } .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 13px; border: 1px solid #d6dce7; border-radius: 12px; background: #f7f9fc; font: inherit; font-size: 15px; color: #18213a; transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8790a6; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #9ba9e9; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #3d5af1; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(61,90,241,0.14); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Document-type nav with blue-mist active row and edge bar.
components.css: .ds-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 220px; padding: 0 16px; background: #fff; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', sans-serif; } .ds-nav { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 46px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: #4a5470; font: inherit; font-weight: 500; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-nav:hover { background: #f7f9fc; color: #18213a; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3d5af1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #edf0ff; color: #2b44c9; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav[aria-pressed='true']::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -16px; top: 10px; bottom: 10px; width: 4px; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; background: #3d5af1; } .ds-count { margin-left: auto; min-width: 22px; padding: 0 7px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: #3d5af1; color: #fff; text-align: center; }

components.name: Status Chips
components.description: Dot-led pills for saved and unsaved state, plus type badges.
components.html: บันทึกแล้ว ยังไม่บันทึก QT-2026-0012
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 26px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-saved { background: #e6f6ee; color: #12965a; } .ds-draft { background: #fff3df; color: #c27400; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 26px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #eef1f6; color: #4a5470; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; }

components.css: .ds-section { max-width: 420px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6eaf1; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,30,60,0.04), 0 10px 28px -14px rgba(20,30,60,0.14); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', sans-serif; color: #18213a; } .ds-section summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 20px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-section summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-section summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3d5af1; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 20px; } .ds-step { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 10px; background: #edf0ff; color: #3d5af1; font-family: 'Prompt', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-title { font-family: 'Prompt', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; } .ds-body { padding: 4px 20px 20px; font-size: 15px; color: #4a5470; }

components.description: Three-way VAT selector with blue-mist selected option.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; max-width: 420px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', sans-serif; } .ds-opt { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 6px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid #d6dce7; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; background: #f7f9fc; color: #4a5470; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-opt:hover { border-color: #9ba9e9; } .ds-opt.on { border-color: #3d5af1; background: #edf0ff; color: #2b44c9; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #3d5af1; }

narrative.overview:
A calm, cool-grey work desk with one sheet of white paper on it. The app chrome is a quiet, modern SaaS surface (white cards on a pale blue-grey canvas, one confident blue), and the A4 document is the hero: a true-white sheet in Sarabun with the user's own accent color, shadowed like paper lying on the desk. The chrome exists to get the user to a correct, printable Thai document fast.

Density is medium and practical: a 236px sidebar, a 380-440px editor column of collapsible numbered steps, and a sticky live preview. Every control is at least 44px tall. Status is always color-coded by document type: blue for quotation, amber for invoice, green for receipt.

The app follows the OS color scheme: a full dark palette remaps every token (canvas #0e1320, primary #6c86ff), while the paper itself stays light.
keyCharacteristics: One blue (#3d5af1) for actions, selection and focus; soft "mist" tints for selected states.
Document-type color coding: quotation blue, invoice amber, receipt green.
White cards with a whisper shadow and 20px corners; 12px controls; pill chips and status badges.
Four-family type system: Prompt headings, IBM Plex Sans Thai UI, IBM Plex Mono numbers, Sarabun on the printed document.
Light and dark schemes; print outputs only the A4 paper.

rules.name: The Type Has A Color Rule
rules.body: Quotation is blue, invoice is amber, receipt is green, everywhere: badges, list stripes, KPI tiles. Never reuse those hues for anything else.

rules.name: The Paper Is Not The App Rule
rules.body: The document uses its own muted accent and Sarabun body text; app blue never appears on the printed sheet.

rules.name: The Numbers Line Up Rule
rules.body: Every amount, count and document number uses tabular numerals (`.num` or IBM Plex Mono).

dos: Do use Ledger Blue (#3d5af1) for the one primary action per view and for focus.
Do keep the quotation / invoice / receipt colors (blue / amber / green) consistent in every surface.
Do keep every control at least 44px tall and use tabular numerals for money.
Do keep Sarabun and the user's accent inside the paper only.
Do keep both the light and dark token sets in sync when adding a color.
donts: Don't use app blue on the printed document.
Don't use `window.alert` or `confirm`; destructive actions confirm inline in Void Red.
Don't add heavy shadows to cards; the paper is the only object that sits clearly above the desk.
